fixed_paragraph: When I encounter a new idea, I prefer to stick with what I already know. When someone suggests trying a new restaurant, I usually opt for my favorite spot instead. When faced with an unfamiliar situation, I rely on my past experiences to guide me. When a friend recommends a book from a genre I don't usually read, I tend to decline. When planning a vacation, I choose destinations I've visited before. When a colleague proposes a different approach to a project, I advocate for the tried-and-true methods. When decorating my home, I stick to classic styles rather than experimenting with trends. When listening to music, I play the same playlists that I know and love. When shopping for clothes, I buy similar styles that I have worn for years.
